intro: The Crate of Inn Supplies is a parcel packed in Coldridge Valley destined for the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. With the mountain pass overrun by troggs, regular supply routes are cut, leaving the inn dependent on passing travelers to carry goods through.

p: Ordinarily, goods flow smoothly between the quiet training grounds of Anvilmar and the bustling towns of Dun Morogh. However, recent trogg incursions have severed Coldridge Pass, cutting off civilian couriers until armed Mountaineer escorts can clear the roads. Packed by Hands Springsprocket, this heavy crate holds essential tavern provisions that Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos has been waiting on anxiously amid the disruption.
